Professional Summary
Senior Go developer with extensive backend and platform experience building scalable microservices, observability, and streaming data pipelines. Strong focus on reliability, performance tuning, and cross-team collaboration in Agile environments.

Technical Skills
Golang, gRPC, k8s, postgresql, Kafka, Prometheus, Jira, Linux, Agile

Work Experience

Senior Go Developer, Paystack India (Dec 2019 - Present)

- Led Kubernetes (k8s) rollout of stateless and stateful services, improving deployment consistency and enabling zero-downtime releases while writing CI pipelines and Linux-based container troubleshooting.
- Designed and tuned PostgreSQL-backed settlement workflows and optimized queries to reduce reconciliation time by 40%; coordinated work using Jira in cross-functional Agile sprints.

Go Developer, CartNest (May 2019 - Nov 2019)
- Built high-throughput order ingestion service in Golang using gRPC for internal RPC and Kafka for event streaming, increasing order processing capacity by 3x.
- Integrated Prometheus metrics and alerts for key service SLIs, enabling rapid detection of backpressure and consumer lag in Kafka pipelines.
- Implemented PostgreSQL data models and indexing strategies for catalog and order storage; performed Linux-based profiling and deployments through k8s clusters tracked via Jira.

Platform Engineer, Orbit Health (May 2018 - Apr 2019)
- Developed containerized platform components in Go to support telehealth services, instrumented with Prometheus for latency and error tracking.
- Automated k8s cluster health checks and Linux host monitoring; collaborated in Agile teams to stabilize CI/CD pipelines and reduce incident resolution time.
- Contributed to service design discussions to improve observability and resiliency across the platform.

Go Developer, Covalent Infotech (Jun 2017 - Apr 2018)
- Implemented backend services in Golang exposing gRPC endpoints and producing events to Kafka for downstream processing.
- Deployed services to Kubernetes clusters and handled runtime Linux operations; wrote health and metrics endpoints consumed by Prometheus.
- Collaborated in Agile cycles using Jira to deliver features and coordinate cross-team integration work.
